Hear your pump.fun coins.

Paste one or more contract addresses. Every trade becomes a note, in time with Solana's slots: each coin's melody follows its price, big trades ring louder, buyers brighten the key and sellers darken it.

  • Buy bell, filled bubble
  • Sell plucked string, ring
  • Price = the melody
  • Each coin its own colour
  • Graduation string swell
  • Slot clock 4 slots = 1 beat
Data source

Sound starts after your click (browser rule). The free public endpoint is rate-limited and not meant for production; if it refuses or drops, try again later, use the demo, or paste your own endpoint. Click a bubble to open its transaction. Not financial advice.
